verdict.rationale: SumUp's first-party docs explicitly state that Tap to Pay lets merchants accept in-person contactless payments directly on a compatible phone without a separate card reader (sumup-docs-9). Tap to Pay is listed alongside physical readers as an in-person payment option (sumup-docs-29) and is available through the mobile SDKs (sumup-docs-38). Missing for 10: details on device/OS compatibility and supported countries, a documented founder onboarding flow (e.g. using it without building an app), and independent or hands-on corroboration.
